GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

What does a rental package include?

Flag-only requests use your compatible display hardware. A display-system request adds poles and bases. The event package also requests delivery, setup, takedown and collection. Exact inclusions are confirmed in the quote.

How are rental prices calculated?

Pricing depends on the flag designs and quantities, equipment, full rental period, venue location and requested services. Share those details for a quote that separates equipment from logistics.

Can I use rental displays outdoors?

Outdoor suitability depends on the selected flag, pole, base, surface and exposure. Describe the venue and placement before choosing equipment; an indoor base is not automatically suitable outside.

What should I confirm before booking?

Confirm availability, the full rental period, included equipment and services, access windows, transport charges and any deposit, damage, change or cancellation terms. A quote request does not reserve equipment.
